messages:
Maria (AE): heads-up: customer sent an MSA redline + order form. They request split billing across two entities and net60 for the POC. Need legal + finance to confirm signer lanes and invoice flow. cc @Raj (SalesOps)

Raj (SalesOps): can we confirm exact legal entity names, VAT for UK, and whether they need separate envelopes per entity? any special tech/security asks in the redline?

Maria (AE): Entities: 'Acme Health Global, Inc.' (US) and 'Acme Health UK Ltd.' (GB), VAT GB999888777. No HSM; they asked DPA to mention KMS rotation. Uploading redline when they send.

contracts-bot: New file uploaded: acme_health_orderform_redline_may2026.pdf

Elaine (Legal): checklist from legal: 1) ensure subprocessors listed or ask customer to provide list; 2) check SLA change requests and escalation paths; 3) confirm who signs MSA vs orderform. recommended routing: MSA -> customer GC; Orderform -> customer AP/Finance. Need fallback signer.

Tomas (Finance): for split invoices we need PO numbers per entity and billing addresses. Net60 for POC acceptable pending controller approval. UK invoices require VAT line and GBP amounts or conversion note. Maria, get PO numbers and currency preference.

Raj (SalesOps): DocuSign routing proposal:
```
Envelope A (MSA): Sender -> Elaine -> Customer GC
Envelope B (Orderform/PO): Sender -> Tomas -> Customer AP
If split: Envelope B-US + Envelope B-UK, reference Envelope A ID.
```

Maria (AE): will request PO numbers, subprocessors list, and primary/fallback signers. will update thread when received. thanks all :thumbsup:
